summary: Comprehensive end-to-end testing of the Overlays/Reeksen/Assets/Scene-Overview restructure. 7/7 backend tests pass (pytest). Frontend: login+MFA OK, all 8 nav paths load without errors, Overlays page shows 'Now Playing overlay' + 'New overlay' buttons with full data-testid coverage (pancarte-card/live/link/dup/edit/del) and Dutch subtitle. Overlay editor exposes 'vMix-link' and 'Live view' buttons; vMix link copies and shows Dutch toast 'vMix overlay-link gekopieerd'; Live view opens dialog with iframe pointing to /api/public/overlay/{token}/overlay. Now Playing graceful toast ('Create a Now Playing (radio) source first...') when source missing. Reeks editor supports library add, per-item seconds via seq-dur-{i}, loop toggle (flow-loop-field) and save; durations [8, 3.5] and loop=false persisted after reload (verified via /api/flows). Scene Overview /scenes/:id/overview renders 'Volledige scene' iframe with scene vMix URL and 'Losse overlays in deze scene' listing each placed reeks with per-overlay copyable vMix link + live view (overview-overlay-link-{id} present). Scene editor regression: Back/Overview/Save/Live view/Export to vMix buttons all present, scene public overlay URL returns 200 HTML. Assets page titled 'Assets' with 'Upload asset' button.
critical_code_review_comments: FlowEditor loop toggle uses a plain <input type=checkbox> inside the flow-loop-field label. Works fine but has no aria-checked, so automated tests must read .checked (not aria-checked). Consider swapping to the shadcn Switch for consistency with the rest of the UI and better test ergonomics.

Pancartes.jsx Now Playing toast text is in English ('Create a Now Playing (radio) source first on the API Sources page.') while the rest of the restructure uses Dutch; consider translating for UX consistency ('Maak eerst een Now Playing (radio) bron aan onder API Sources.').

Clipboard.writeText throws 'permission denied' inside the sandboxed iframe used by the automation runner — not a bug in prod browsers, but the toast still fires via optimistic path. Consider wrapping in try/catch to show a fallback toast if the write fails.
seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted: 1 TEST_Overlay_1 (pancarte) and 1 TEST_Reeks_UI (flow with durations [8, 3.5], loop=false). Used existing Demo Scene (id=00d3c887-a4fc-4cb5-856c-695caaadd689, token=197f79668c7a450cb48093af6e1a5387) and Demo Reeks with Kaart A/Kaart B overlays for regression + Scene Overview assertions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full restructure (designs→Overlays, flows→Reeksen, uploads→Assets) is production-green. Per-overlay public endpoints /api/public/overlay/{token}/(overlay|version|values.json) return 200/JSON and backfill tokens on first list. FlowInput.durations[]+loop persist round-trip. SceneOverview page emits overview-scene-card, overview-scene-live, overview-scene-link, overview-reeks-{id}, overview-overlay-{id}, overview-overlay-live-{id}, overview-overlay-link-{id} testids. Note: API Sources route is /sources (not /api-sources) to avoid colliding with the /api ingress prefix.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. One minor code-quality nit: the 'Now Playing overlay' template button toast is English while the rest of the restructure UI is Dutch; cosmetic only.
